decisions.reason: Although the responsive website template is related to the firm's web and CMS knowledge, its absence from the website after 2019 and the firm's stronger absorptive capacity in hosting and operational services make withdrawal and resource reallocation plausible.
Premium customer support lies at the center of the firm's established service routines, 24/7 operations, and customer knowledge, so the firm is well placed to keep improving and commercializing it.

The software version management tool builds on the firm's in-house development and platform know-how, and even if it may be increasingly bundled into broader services, the firm's absorptive capacity still supports retaining it.
Scalable hosting for agencies is highly aligned with the firm's core infrastructure, agency focus, and stated strategic direction, making continued retention the most likely choice.
